title: Complaint Handling Procedure
policy_text: Every complaint is logged in the complaints system on the day it is received. The complaints team acknowledges each complaint in writing within 2 business days. A final response letter is sent within 30 calendar days of receipt, explaining the outcome and the customer's right to escalate. Complaint files, including all letters and emails with the customer, are retained for 7 years after the final response.

title: Complaint Root Cause Analysis Standard
policy_text: The complaints quality team groups complaints by product and cause every quarter. Findings and recommended fixes are presented to the Executive Risk Committee each quarter, and owners are assigned to each fix.

title: Records Retention Standard
policy_text: Account opening records are kept for 7 years after the relationship ends. Transaction records are kept for 7 years. Customer communications, including emails, letters and complaint correspondence, are deleted 5 years after they were created, to limit the personal data the bank holds.

title: Regulatory Requests Procedure
policy_text: Requests for information from supervisors are logged by Regulatory Affairs, assigned an owner and answered within the deadline set by the supervisor, or within 10 business days if none is given.

title: Fees and Charges Disclosure Policy
policy_text: Fees are disclosed in the account schedule before an account is opened. Before an overdraft fee is charged on a card or app transaction, the app shows the fee and lets the customer cancel. Customers receive a monthly statement of all fees charged, with a year-to-date total.

title: Pricing Change Notification Procedure
policy_text: Customers are given at least 60 days' written notice before any fee on a deposit account increases. Notices are sent by the customer's preferred channel and the change is published on the website on the same day.

title: Privacy and Data Subject Rights Procedure
policy_text: Requests from customers for a copy of their personal data are logged in the privacy request tracker with the date received, the date answered and the outcome. Requests are answered within 30 calendar days.

title: Personal Data Breach Response Procedure
policy_text: Suspected personal data breaches are reported to the Privacy Office immediately. The Privacy Office notifies the Financial Data Protection Office within 72 hours of the bank becoming aware of a breach, and notifies affected customers without undue delay when the risk to them is high.

title: Marketing Consent Standard
policy_text: Electronic marketing is sent only to customers who have opted in. The date, channel and wording of each opt-in are stored in the consent register. Withdrawals of consent are applied within 5 days.

title: Operational Resilience Policy
policy_text: The bank maintains a list of important business services, each with an impact tolerance for maximum tolerable disruption. The Board approves the list and tolerances annually. Each service is tested against severe but plausible scenarios at least once a year.

title: Business Continuity Standard
policy_text: Each business unit keeps a continuity plan with recovery time objectives and contact trees. Plans are reviewed annually and tested every two years.

title: Payment Outage Communication Procedure
policy_text: When customers cannot make payments, Payments Operations posts a status message in the mobile app and on the website within 1 hour, and updates it every 2 hours until service is restored.

title: Third-Party Risk Management Policy
policy_text: All suppliers are recorded in the supplier register with a criticality rating. Suppliers that support important business services are reviewed for performance and risk at least once a year. Each critical supplier has a documented exit plan that is tested every two years.

title: Cloud Outsourcing Standard
policy_text: Cloud services that hold customer data require a security assessment before use, contractual audit rights, and data location controls.

title: Customer Due Diligence Policy
policy_text: Customers are identified and verified before an account is opened. For business customers, every individual owning 25 percent or more is identified and verified before account opening. Beneficial ownership for high-risk business customers is refreshed every year, and for other business customers every three years.

title: Suspicious Activity Reporting Procedure
policy_text: Alerts are investigated by the financial intelligence unit. Suspicious activity reports are filed within 30 calendar days of first detection. Volumes and timeliness are reported to the Board Risk Committee each quarter.

title: Sanctions Screening Standard
policy_text: Customers and payments are screened against sanctions lists. When a sanctions list is updated, the full customer base is rescreened within 24 hours of publication.

title: Payment Fraud Prevention Policy
policy_text: Outgoing instant payments are scored by the real-time fraud engine before release. Customers can report fraud by phone or in the app 24 hours a day, every day.

title: Scam Reimbursement Procedure
policy_text: Scam claims are assessed against the reimbursement standard. Eligible victims are reimbursed within 5 business days unless there is evidence of gross negligence or first-party fraud. A confirmation-of-payee check runs before the first payment to a new payee, and a warning is shown when the name does not match.

title: Vulnerable Customers Policy
policy_text: With the customer's consent, colleagues record disclosed vulnerabilities in the customer profile so service can be adapted. All customer-facing colleagues complete vulnerability training every year.

title: Accessibility Standard
policy_text: Statements and important notices are available in large print, braille and screen-reader friendly formats on request, free of charge.

title: Credit Card Statement Standard
policy_text: Monthly card statements show the balance, the minimum payment, the due date, and a minimum-payment warning with the time to repay and total interest if only the minimum is paid.

title: Credit Card Collections Procedure
policy_text: Collections agents contact customers in arrears by phone, text and letter. Calls about one debt are limited to 7 in any 7-day period. Requests to be contacted only in writing are recorded and honored.

title: Mortgage Arrears Management Procedure
policy_text: A borrower who misses a payment is contacted within 10 calendar days. Borrowers in financial difficulty are offered forbearance options, including temporary payment reductions and term extensions, before any repossession proceedings start.

title: Mortgage Underwriting Policy
policy_text: Applications are assessed for affordability using verified income and a stressed interest rate. Loan-to-value limits are set by product.

title: Liquidity Risk Policy
policy_text: Liquidity stress tests run monthly and include a rapid digital deposit outflow scenario. The bank holds liquid assets sufficient to cover net outflows in its most severe scenario for at least 30 days.

title: Capital Planning Policy
policy_text: Capital forecasts are produced quarterly and stress tested annually. The Board sets a minimum capital buffer above regulatory requirements.

title: Cyber Incident Response Policy
policy_text: Security incidents are triaged by the security operations center. Significant cyber incidents are reported to the Prudential Banking Board within 24 hours of being classified as significant. A final report with root cause and remediation follows within 30 days of resolution.

title: Information Security Policy
policy_text: Access to systems follows least privilege and is reviewed quarterly. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Vulnerabilities rated critical are patched within 14 days.

title: Model Risk Management Policy
policy_text: Credit scorecards and pricing models built by the bank are validated by an independent model validation team before use and revalidated every two years. Model owners monitor performance monthly.

title: Fair Lending Policy
policy_text: Credit decisions are made on objective criteria. Approval and pricing outcomes are tested for disparities across protected groups each quarter, and declined applicants receive the principal reasons for the decision.

title: Advertising and Financial Promotions Standard
policy_text: Advertisements are fair, clear and not misleading. Every promotion is approved by Compliance before release and representative rates are shown with equal prominence.

title: Product Governance Policy
policy_text: New products and material changes are approved by the Product Committee after a review of target market, value and risks. Products are reviewed every year.

title: Conflicts of Interest Policy
policy_text: Colleagues declare outside interests annually. Incentive schemes are reviewed so they do not reward outcomes that harm customers.

title: Whistleblowing Policy
policy_text: Colleagues can raise concerns confidentially through a hotline. Reports are investigated independently and reported to the Audit Committee.

title: Mandatory Training Standard
policy_text: All colleagues complete annual training on conduct, financial crime, information security and data protection. Completion is tracked and reported monthly.

title: Deposit Account Terms Policy
policy_text: Deposit account terms are written in plain language and given to customers before account opening. Dormant accounts are identified after 12 months without activity.

title: Small Business Lending Policy
policy_text: Small business loans are underwritten on cash flow and collateral. Personal guarantees are explained to guarantors in writing.

title: Regulatory Change Management Procedure
policy_text: New regulatory publications are logged within 5 business days, assessed for applicability, mapped to policies and controls, and any gaps are assigned an owner and a due date before the effective date.

title: Code of Conduct
policy_text: Colleagues act with integrity, treat customers fairly and speak up when something is wrong.
